mapper.insert:
insert into MST_HOLIDAY(CALENDAR_ID,CDATE, DATA_SOURCE,STATUS, IS_HOLIDAY,CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT,CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER,UPDATE_TIME, ERR_MSG) select A.* from (
select #{item.calendarId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CALENDAR_ID, #{item.cdate,jdbcType=DATE} CDATE, #{item.dataSource,jdbcType=VARCHAR} DATA_SOURCE, #{item.status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} STATUS,
#{item.isHoliday,jdbcType=INTEGER} IS_HOLIDAY,
null IS_HOLIDAY,
#{item.createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_USER, #{item.createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_DEPT, #{item.createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} CREATE_TIME, #{item.updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UPDATE_USER, #{item.updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} UPDATE_TIME,
#{item.errMsg,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ERR_MSG
null ERR_MSG
from dual
) A ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE CALENDAR_ID=A.CALENDAR_ID, CDATE=A.CDATE, DATA_SOURCE=A.DATA_SOURCE, STATUS=A.STATUS, IS_HOLIDAY=A.IS_HOLIDAY, UPDATE_USER=A.UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME=NOW(), ERR_MSG=A.ERR_MSG
mapper.select:
select count(1) from MST_HOLIDAY where (CALENDAR_ID,CDATE) in
(#{item.CALENDAR_ID},#{item.CDATE})

SELECT T1.CALENDAR_ID calendarId , T1.CDATE cdate , T1.IS_HOLIDAY isHoliday , T1.UPDATE_TIME updateTime, T1.UPDATE_USER updateUser, T2.CALENDAR_NAME calendarName, T1.STATUS status, T1.ERR_MSG errMsg, null orgData from MST_HOLIDAY T1 left join MST_CALENDAR_INFO T2 on T1.CALENDAR_ID = T2.CALENDAR_ID where (CALENDAR_ID,CDATE) in
(#{item.calendarId},#{item.cdate})
union all SELECT T1.CALENDAR_ID calendarId , T1.CDATE cdate , T1.IS_HOLIDAY isHoliday , T1.UPDATE_TIME updateTime, T1.UPDATE_USER updateUser, T2.CALENDAR_NAME calendarName, T1.STATUS status, T1.ERR_MSG errMsg, T1.ORG_DATA orgData from MST_HOLIDAY_ERRODATA T1 left join MST_CALENDAR_INFO T2 on T1.CALENDAR_ID = T2.CALENDAR_ID where (CALENDAR_ID,CDATE) in
(#{item.calendarId},#{item.cdate})
ORDER BY calendarId ASC,cdate DESC
